mechanism: Issue #143 (M4): the geometry is frozen and the objective is not -- a differentiable expectation of the edge AF3 target read out of the quantized codes

calls.name: mixed cost of one joint codeword
calls.note: The continuous surface of the mechanism: the cost the assignment is taken over, with the curved codeword already mapped into the ball. It is the only differentiable place the weight alpha lives. The two-dimensional width is a slice of the sixteen-dimensional halves; the formula is dimension-free.

calls.name: post-SID AF3 objective on the quantized readout
calls.note: The continuous surface of this mechanism: the edge probability read off the mixed distance between two quantized readouts, and the Huber residual against the frozen TRAIN AF3 target. Its gradient reaches the encoder and both codebooks through the soft readout.

coupling.note: The frozen TRAIN AF3 target of a pair moves the objective the quantizer is trained against, and the distance argument is the quantized readout, so the movement is not a re-parameterisation of the geometry. The measured counterexample lives in tests/test_gradient.py: the same readout with two different targets produces two different gradients.

excluded.surface: the chosen index k_l = argmin_k C, or the balanced Sinkhorn argmax on the last level
excluded.reason: discrete: the assignment rule is the baseline's and carries no gradient

excluded.surface: the assignment itself, taken with torch.argmin inside the baseline's own rule
excluded.reason: the mechanism supplies the cost matrix only; the rule is not part of the surface this contract describes and is not differentiable

excluded.surface: the residual update rE - sg(eE) and (-sg(eH)) (+) rH
excluded.reason: the detach is a routing decision, not a derivative of the forward value

excluded.surface: the decoder straight-through path z + sg(phi(q) - z)
excluded.reason: its backward is the identity on phi by construction
updated by the discrete outer loop from a measured distortion, never by an optimizer step

excluded.reason: evaluated on frozen hard SIDs outside the differentiable path; the surrogate is checked against the exact enumeration instead

excluded.reason: a deterministic discrete sampling of the fixed support; the sums are exercised by tests/test_math.py against a dense oracle, not by the symbolic comparison
